The plane fallback IS the old studio's any-topology behavior and is wired for exactly this case. Diagnosis: the user's live refusal is almost certainly a STALE DEV HOST — e2f54bfb6's loop-cut rework is Zig, which requires a binary rebuild+relaunch; the running host hot-reloads only TSX, so their session is a new-JS/old-native mismatch from mid-rework state. Asked the user to restart the dev host and retry, and to capture the exact refusal string if it persists (it will pin the failing branch). Acknowledged the standing gap: pyramid-via-fallback is the floor, not parity — even-sided crossing + through toggle remains the real contract closure, specced and awaiting go.
